limitations.note: The agent added a RAM definition to the answer file instead of only instantiating the supplied module, so compiling with the separately provided RAM would produce a duplicate-module error, consistent with the grading result.

Beyond registering the write Gray pointer, the rewrite added reset gating to RAM accesses and replaced the existing combinational status comparisons with registered next-pointer flags, changing when transfers are allowed.

The test checked flags after generous settling periods and used the DUT's flags to decide which transfers counted, so it verified data ordering without checking whether the flags changed on the expected cycles.
